title.zh: 依第 11 条作出的公告

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-19-2000-NOTIFICATION-UNDER-SECTION-11.pdf》（1 页），本次切分 1 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en:
5th. 2000 No. S 19 EMERGENCY (COPYRIGHT) ORDER, 1999 NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 1(1) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 ( 1), the Attorney General, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st. May, 2000 as the day on which the Emergency (Copyright) Order, 1999 shall commence. Dated this 15th. day of Zulhijah, 1420 Hijriah corresponding to the 22nd. day of March, 2000.

DATO PADUKA AWANG KIFRAWI BIN

DATO PADUKA HAJI KIFLI

ATTORNEY GENERAL, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
